item.title: Trump hints at possible Strait of Hormuz deal amid Iran-Oman talks
item.description: President Trump said progress has been made on reopening the Strait of Hormuz and suggested a deal could be announced soon.

item.title: Influencer fatally shot while livestreaming outside restaurant
item.description: Cesar Gastelum, a TikTok personality with over 600,000 followers, was killed during a live broadcast with two friends.

item.title: El-Sayed wins Michigan Senate primary; coalition-building now key test
item.description: El-Sayed's narrower-than-expected win signals the real challenge ahead: uniting the coalition needed for victory.

item.title: Tiger sharks spotted off New England coast
item.description: Two brothers fishing off Massachusetts caught a tiger shark as sightings rise in Northeast waters.
